rules.title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance – Security Deposit Interest
rules.requirement: For rental units that are fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Stabilization Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit each year, including a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before year end.
rules.key_value: Annual interest on deposit (rate set by Rent Board)
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, as determined by the Rent Board's coverage guide (most multifamily units built before 1980 fully covered; newer units, condos, certain subsidized units, and post-1996 single-family tenancies partially covered).
rules.exemptions: Units wholly exempt from the Rent Ordinance (e.g., certain newer construction, government-owned units not otherwise subsidized) are not subject to this interest requirement.
rules.citation: Berkeley Mun. Code ch. 13.76 (Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is fully, partially, or not covered by Berkeley's Rent Stabilization Ordinance (per coverage guide factors such as building age, tenancy start date, and subsidy status)
